core_claims.name: MTy / Term
core_claims.scope: Full intrinsic extension with unary naturals, functions/fixpoints, primitive Nat literals/multiplication, let, products/projections/two-binder Split, sums, unit/UnitCase, empty/Absurd, and lists/ListCase.

core_claims.name: rename / subst / extendRen / extendSub
core_claims.scope: Type-preserving renaming and simultaneous substitution cover every constructor, extending twice under product and list destructuring branches.

core_claims.name: double / inst2
core_claims.scope: Simultaneous two-variable substitution with order second::first::gamma; product branch binds second/first, list branch tail/head. All further binders weaken replacements correctly.

core_claims.name: Value / Step
core_claims.scope: Weak strict left-to-right CBV dynamics for all constructs, including value premises on both pair fields and list components, selected sum branches, primitive multiplication, let beta and general recursion.

core_claims.name: progress / emptyValue
core_claims.scope: Every closed intrinsic term of any extended type is a value or can step; no closed value exists at EmptyT. This does not exclude closed diverging terms at EmptyT.

core_claims.name: valueNormal
core_claims.scope: Every value in every context and at every extended type has no one-step reduct, covering all extended value constructors.

core_claims.name: evaluate / runPrimitive / runUnary
core_claims.scope: Total fuelled evaluator producing a finite trace plus value/exhaustion evidence for the entire extended language.

core_claims.name: cubeTwo / cubeComputed / lengthComputed / emptyLoopStep
core_claims.scope: Actual four-step let-based primitive cube trace, cube result Just 8, recursive length result Just 2, and a closed self-loop at EmptyT.

exercises.scope: Product destructuring substitutes three and five in the specified first/second positions.
Left sum branch selection substitutes the payload seven and ignores the right branch.
List cons branch substitutes head/tail and selects the head at index one.

deviations: Formalized sums, unit, empty and lists from upstream explanatory sections/exercises in addition to its executable primitive/let/product core.
The double-binder operation is defined directly as simultaneous substitution. The optional upstream double-subst equation comparing particular sequential substitutions is not supplied or claimed.
The prose explains translations between projections and pair-pattern matching, but does not claim a general proved equivalence of the two product formulations.
Fuel accounting uses a finite trace and value/exhaustion evidence rather than an exact gas-indexed length relation.

verification.compiler: Idris2 0.8.0 via the pinned Nix environment
verification.totality: %default total; no proof holes, postulates, unsafe casts, or termination overrides
verification.independent_acceptance: to be recorded by the primary editor
